total_frames.description: Independently reviewed full scene duration, matching ARDJ and Stage; not the last camera key. A 132-frame scene may have its last movement key at frame 120.

stage_name.description: Working composition in the v1.13 master; output rig is 02_camera.

layout_source.description: Path relative to the current project scene folder; must remain inside its LO directory.

replace_existing.description: Set true only with explicit authorization to replace different existing camera keys.

frame.description: 1-based cumulative scene frame, not a zero-based AE time index.

rect.description: Original LO pixel line centers: [left, top, right, bottom].

slow.description: True only at an ending key whose movement explicitly says Slow on the sheet; first key must be false.

evidence.description: Current sheet/LO source paths, image hashes, notes and visual review evidence; do not reuse another scene's values.
